classification: public market and issuer research data; no account, position, token, credential or connection configuration
limitations: Actual original timestamps are preserved. Enforce published_at and first_seen_at visibility. Embedding created_at, consensus captured_at and filing/accepted timestamps also matter. Export time does not prove historical availability.
Graph is a current snapshot, not historical versions. Check first_discovered_at, reviewed_at and exposure_asof. Current membership alone does not prove historical membership.
Marketstate has limited historical coverage; empty windows are missing, not zero. M7 is not merged; use accepted contract/fixtures, no unmerged implementation.

Stored mktcap applies only to its actual trade_date. No TTM PE is invented. Use only PIT-valid matching price, positive earnings and currency; otherwise NULL with reason. Ordinary shares cannot substitute for diluted shares.
No account or actual holdings data. Synthetic holding priority tests must be clearly labelled.
Canonical case source coverage may be incomplete. Frozen recordings/synthetic inputs/real exports must be distinguished. These data do not establish historical search availability.
News export contains title/summary only, matching the data request. Any quotation or mechanism unsupported by these fields needs a source or explicit missing reason; do not fabricate it.
2026-10-09 precedes 2026-10-14: earlier OpenAI material is context, not a later second hit. Do not change timestamps to pass tests.
scope: Current configured baskets/constituents, their one-hop entities, and targeted Toshiba/TDK/OpenAI/CoreWeave/Muse/DeepSeek/CPI/Barclays headline/summary matches in the listed windows; no full news body or raw payload included.
